## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: name and address changes, records, legal presence and the road test
Knowledge facts: part C holds 30 fact blocks (sec01-F01 onward) from physical pages 6 to 8; part C2 holds 12 confusable blocks (sec01-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer, the September 2026 revision line and the written-test requirement; question count, passing standard, format and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- AZ-REC-A-COUNT — written-test question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-REC-A-PASS — passing standard not printed; nothing shown to learners (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- AZ-REC-A-FORMAT — item format not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-REC-A-TIME — time limit not printed (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-REC-A-EDITION — issuer current-edition confirmation pending; issuer page was bot-challenged at intake (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-REC-D-MILITARY — five-year license option for military personnel is only referenced, not described (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- AZ-REC-E-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- AZ-REC-ETWO-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: fees, office closure days, online services and identification requirements (for example sec01-F02, sec01-F05, sec01-F24) can change and must be refreshed from azdot.gov or AZMVDNow.gov.
Index: exam authority in A; audience in B; knowledge facts with misconceptions, mnemonics, glossary and dynamic-fact lines in C; confusables in C2; accuracy in D; market in E and E2; definition-of-done matrix in G.

corpus_stability.reason: The Arizona Driver License Manual carries one revision line on its contents page (Revised September 2026) and points to Arizona Revised Statutes Title 28 for current law; nothing in the selected pages signals more than one rewrite per year.
